facts.fact: The Minister of Lands, Housing and Urban Development, Judith Nabakooba, described the Uganda National Land Information System (UGNLIS) as a public portal where citizens can check land status, confirm ownership and track transactions.

The Minister said citizens can check land status and confirm ownership on the UGNLIS public portal, and the author urged landowners to check land interests through digitalised land services before transactions.
